text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I head to the shopping
district for some shopping.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Why, if it isn't my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Might you be here to carry my bags?
Heh-heh, I'm touched! Now work
to your
heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No worries, I don't mind. You can get that
over with along the way. As
you know, I
am nothing if not magnanimous!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I get roped into Agnes
Tachyon's shopping trip.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A single tomato provides a
non-insignificant amount of nutrition, and

yet this cumbersome body of mine still
demands more.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So I'll get a tomato... and three steamed
chicken breasts to make a
salad. I can't
neglect my protein intake if I want to see
muscle growth.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Agh, what a hassle.
If only I could sustain
myself solely on
supplements.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, isn't eating just an act to
replenish our nutrients?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Most sources of nutrients can be absorbed
even if they're ingested in
their base state.
In some cases such as lycopene, ingesting
processed foods is more efficient.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, I have no time to waste on
cooking. Usually, I just throw
everything I
buy into a food processor and call it a
day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I don't want to waste even a
second on oral
replenishment. Time is
finite, my dear Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The more I hear about Agnes Tachyon's
diet, the more worried I get.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sigh... If the cafeteria was always open, I wouldn't have to waste my time shopping.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You, cook?! Haha! Should I call you
devoted or just subservient?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I can't rule out the possibility that you
may
have developed an
addiction to serving
me after all of our experiments.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, fine by me. It'll free up my day.
Not a bad idea at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's decided—I'll leave dinner to you.
Attend to me with all your
being!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, and don't make anything too high in
calories. Make sure to
prepare something
nutritionally balanced.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And now I'm in charge of Agnes Tachyon's
meal prep.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, calling me out at this
time?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oooh,
that's right! I was so absorbed in my
research that I forgot to
eat.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You see, I decided to go back to basics.
Like the pursuit of
faster-than-light speed,
unlocking the potential of Umamusume 
requires the use of four-momentum—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What are you so riled up about? In any
case, my research is in a good place. I
won't need you for some time, but you can
look forward to it
all the same.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'll take that food off your hands, but I
must return to my lab
posthaste—my
research begs for a resolution.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next morning...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rattle...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yawn... Good morning, Trainer. Here, my lunchbox.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon thrusts an empty lunchbox
into my hands.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Vitamins, minerals, proteins... Lipids and carbohydrates, too. All present. I give it an A for balance.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't unpalatable. But there are two
things you can improve for
next time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
First—I consumed the food during the
downtime between experiments, but
having to use chopsticks proved to be a
hassle. Fix
that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Second—there was far too little rice to
accompany the main dish. Add
some more
to balance things out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I assume today's portion is a lost cause,
but I expect these flaws to be
ironed out
moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My breakfast, of course. You do have it,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's time for me to return to the lab.
Come
on, hand it over.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You didn't make me breakfast?! You're
kidding me! You're telling me
I left my
research for this?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Didn't you promise to prepare my meals?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Do I have to ask you for every meal?! That
would be way too
inefficient!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's your job to look after me! So give me
something to eat, pronto!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I said now! I want to eat now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I can only suppress this craving with
nourishment—or experimentation
at your
expense.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, pick your poison. Either make me
food or fulfill your role as my
guinea pig.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me. I'll move our experiment to
the afternoon, so hurry up
with that
breakfast, will you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Naturally—it's your duty as my guinea pig.
Making me food is your
duty as my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Going all the way to the cafeteria is too
much of a pain. I think I'll go
take a nap,
so wake me up when the food is ready.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm not asking for much. Feel free to
use the leftover ingredients
from
yesterday's meal. You still have them, I
assume?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: All right, hop to it! Hurry up and make me food!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad Tachyon has an interest in food
again, but does she really
expect me to
make her food every day?
